policies.action: Require position, format, current level, target level and relevant assessment context; compare only compatible benchmarks; coach prioritizes rather than maximizing every quality.
Track mass with speed, strength, power and conditioning trends; do not prescribe mass gain or infer injury protection from mass alone.
Use comparable measurement methods and contextual age, maturation, sex, health and position; no automatic weight or fat targets.
Keep movement categories and absolute/relative strength distinct; track longitudinally; record external and system mass separately where relevant.
Keep strength and power distinct; use absolute and relative measures where appropriate; force/velocity limitation remains a hypothesis pending suitable testing.
Keep acceleration and maximal speed separate; retain splits and protocol; distinguish development priorities.
Separate aerobic capacity, repeated sprint ability and repeated high-intensity effort ability; match format and position; track performance decrement.

guardrails: Missing or incompatible benchmark requires review
No automatic prescription or medical clearance
decision_contract.priority_policy: Use coach-approved rugby relevance and comparable assessment gaps; do not rank unlike metrics by raw numeric difference.
